hits.title: Scale AI Appoints Francis deSouza as CEO to Lead Next Phase of Company’s Growth | Scale AI
hits.snippet: Scale AI today announced that its Board of Directors has appointed Francis deSouza as Chief Executive Officer, effective August 10, 2026. The appointment comes as Scale's momentum accelerates, with customer growth across both its data and applications businesses. Recent wins include the addition of enterprise customers such as BP and Mayo Clinic, along with expanded business with both U.S. and international governments. Jason Droege, who has led the company as interim CEO since June 2025, will work closely with Francis over the coming months to help with the transition.

hits.snippet: Scale AI has committed itself to a different commercial architecture than the one it was built on. Appointing a security executive as CEO is an operational signal: the company's original revenue base — labelled-data contracts with AI labs — is not the growth surface the board is now betting on. Government and defence procurement, alongside regulated enterprise verticals, runs on trust frameworks, compliance architecture, and cleared-facility relationships that most AI infrastructure companies don't have and can't improvise. The board is staking the next chapter on leadership that already holds those relationships at an institutional level, rather than building them incrementally from a product-sales motion. This is one of twelve leadership-change signals we have tracked in the last 90 days.
